***The Company expects the new platform to generate orders from existing and new drone manufacturers***


Rehovot, Israel, Oct. 20, 2026 — Maris-Tech Ltd. (Nasdaq: MTEK, MTEKW) (“Maris-Tech” or the “Company”), a global leader in edge computing, artificial intelligence (“AI”), and video intelligence solutions for defense applications, today announced the launch of Uranus-Drones-V2, a compact video and AI processing platform designed for integration into unmanned aerial vehicles (“UAVs”).


Uranus-Drones-V2 supports up to four ultra high definition (UHD) camera inputs and eight camera inputs in total, with processing capabilities exceeding 30 tera operations per second (TOPS). The platform is designed to support a range of drone applications, including surveillance, tracking, and loitering munitions.


The platform connects directly to the drone’s autopilot and incorporates onboard inertial and environmental sensors. Combined with its video and AI processing capabilities, these features enable high-level autonomous flight functionality. Its small size, low weight, and low power consumption support integration into drones with demanding size, weight, and power requirements.


Building on its experience supplying video processing technology to the drone market, Maris-Tech believes Uranus-Drones-V2 will address the evolving requirements of drone manufacturers and expects the platform to generate orders from both existing and new customers.


Israel Bar, Chief Executive Officer of Maris-Tech, commented, “Uranus-Drones-V2 is the result of the Company’s deep understanding and extensive experience in the drone market, gained through thousands of operational deployments. It delivers impressive performance on a platform that is small, lightweight, and low power.”


**About Maris-Tech Ltd.**


Maris-Tech delivers AI-powered edge video solutions for mission-critical defense and security operations, enabling real-time situational awareness, intelligence gathering, and surveillance in bandwidth- and latency-constrained environments. Trusted by leading security organizations, Maris-Tech platforms are deployed across UAVs, UGVs, armored vehicles, and dismounted soldier systems, supporting missions that require ultra-low-latency video processing and onboard AI analytics. From intelligence collection in extreme conditions to AI-driven surveillance and terrain dominance, Maris-Tech masters the AI video pipeline at the edge through best-in-class SWaP-optimized, ruggedized computing solutions.
